purpose: Single entry authority: closed-bar cognition with volume classes → S4.1 commands → LIVE1B books. LIVE1A journal is never an entry source.

invariants.must: production entry_source is s41_command_bus; LIVE1B S41CommandConsumer is constructed; journal poll is observe-only
when entry_source=s41_command_bus, CONTEXT_START/FLIP must not open a LIVE1B position
PROVISIONAL_INTRABAR resolve_timeframe_state is not actionable for S4.1
untagged lifecycle parquet is M15-only; H1 without own rows is NO_LIFECYCLE_ROW, not M15 direction
same lifecycle_episode_id must not OPEN again after TP/SL/CLOSE; FLIP to opposite episode still allowed
LONG open + SHORT_CONTEXT ACTIVE in one manager cycle emits CLOSE and opposite OPEN (or intent FLIP), not CLOSE alone
ENTRY_BLOCKED_EXECUTION_MARKET_NOT_READY and missing local BBO must not consume the command_id
S4.1 actionable context is closed-bar parquet lineage, not LIVE1A volume_class=unknown
entry_source=s41_command_bus paints parquet lifecycle bands, not LIVE1A journal
hybrid cutover and VPS bootstrap write entry_source=s41_command_bus and do not say S4.1 is not entry authority
